notes.title: Upcoming CYBRLICH Events
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings corporate slackers and skeleton slayers. We hope this email finds you well. [/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341349/e9c3c781fc66ae07bf1a90368457a7292ccee2f2.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Have you been itching for a chance to play CYBRLICH and the Death Cult of Labor? We'll be on the ground at two events in New York City soon! [/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341349/2a19697d2be09e75b0f0e9e00f22289f11dee03c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Thursday, July 24th,[/b] from 6pm - 10pm you can catch us at [b]BrookLAN's NYC Indie Dev Night.[/b][/h3][p][url="https://www.eventbrite.com/e/nyc-indie-dev-night-tickets-858271421927" style="button" buttoncolor="#fa6869"]NYC INDIE DEV NIGHT[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341349/fac99a1732be761ea7c633cd0a0416404117ed35.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]August 22 - 24,[/b] we'll be at [b]Anime NYC[/b] as part of the [b]PLAY.nyc[/b] experience.[/h3][p][url="https://animenyc.com/" style="button" buttoncolor="#fe6765"]ANIME.NYC[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h3]Want to stay up to date on all things CYBRLICH? [b]Join our discord![/b] Discord members see all of our new content first, and it's also a chill place to hang. Who doesn't want more friends?[/h3][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/8UMbBTHqsP" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff6665"]CYBRLICH DISCORD[/url][/p][p] [/p][h3]Finally, we encourage all CYBRLICH fans to [b]pre-save our Kickstarter campaign.[/b] This isn't a pledge for money, it just lets you get notified when our campaign goes live. These pre-saves help us out tremendously, so please sign up! You'll receive our undying gratitude.[/h3][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cybrlich/cybrlich-and-the-death-cult-of-labor" style="button" buttoncolor="#ff6665"]KICKSTARTER PRE-SAVE[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]
Hope to see you at BrookLAN and PLAY.nyc!

Kind Regards,
CYBRLICH Studios

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341349/4bccbfdf0a7f011e07fac69b4e39445adc3c17c7.gif"][/img][/h3]
